registered: 2026-10-11T10:55-04:00 (before full runs; L0/L1 pilots of 1000 tasks each were run to debug the harness and are excluded)
unit: one task = one row in results/<rung>.jsonl
primary_metric: solve rate under the rung's gate, Wilson 95% CI
secondary: rank of the solving candidate (log2 rank = search bits)
reported_j per solved task: RAPL on jetson-hub for a stratified subsample; elsewhere est_j = cpu_s x 10 W, labeled as an estimate

hypotheses.H0: On L0, G0-T solves >= 99% of valid mutants with 0 model calls.
hypotheses.H1: On L1 (TSSB-3M, ManySStuBs4J), G0-T + G1 solve a share at least equal to the share of single-token bug patterns in the corpus (operator, literal, boolean, and/or swaps), with 0 model calls.
hypotheses.H2: On L2-L4 (Defects4J), G1-J reaches TBar PerfectFL correct counts on the same bugs.
hypotheses.H5: On L5, the deterministic arm (no model) is reported separately from the local-model arm; the model arm's accepted programs are compiled into the G0 index and re-solved with 0 calls.

power: Wilson half-width w at p=0.5 needs n = 1.96^2 * 0.25 / w^2: n = 9604 for w = 0.01, 384 for w = 0.05. Target per rung: n >= 9604 where the corpus allows (L0, L1), full corpus otherwise (Defects4J 835 active bugs, HumanEval 164, MBPP 974 test split / 500 sanitized, SWE-bench Lite 300, Verified 500). Achievable N is recorded per rung.
sampling: seeded shuffle (seed 20261011) of the full population; the first N in that order are run; no task is dropped after it is run
stopping: a rung run stops at its preregistered N or when the population is exhausted; engine changes after a run open a new run id and the earlier run stays reported
exclusions: only generator-invalid tasks (mutant inside a string, comment or docstring; TSSB rows whose diff does not parse into one changed statement), decided by rule before running

splits.rule: Per corpus, after the seeded shuffle (seed 20261011): positions 0..1999 are DEV (engine tuning allowed; never reported as results), positions >= 2000 are TEST. Per RCE paper section 8.4: the engine is frozen and committed, its binary hash recorded, before a TEST run; results are frozen-engine numbers on TEST only. Any engine change after a TEST run opens a new run id on tasks no earlier engine was tuned on.

dev_used.L0: G0-T was designed from failures on commons-lang mutants, and pilots ran on requests and flask: those three repositories are DEV in full; L0 TEST = the other 9 repositories

splits.note_corpus20: The Track A corpus20 20/20 is dev-contaminated (rules committed after the first run on it) and is not a ladder result.
